name: 吸附等温线与孔径分布 (N2 Isotherm & Pore Size Distribution)
when: Physisorption characterization: N2 adsorption-desorption isotherms (paired solid/hollow or dual-branch markers vs P/P0) or pore size distribution (dV/dlog(W) vs pore diameter).

required_slots.x: Relative pressure P/P0 in [0, 1] for isotherms; Pore diameter (nm) for PSD.
required_slots.series: Paired Adsorption/Desorption columns per sample (Fig2B: 16 cols = 4 samples x 2 branches x (x,y)), OR dV/dlog(W) column per sample (FigS6).

optional_slots.branch_type: ads vs des marker style (e.g. filled vs open or differentiated symbol).
optional_slots.scale_offsets: Optional y-shift if separating overlapping isotherms (Fig2B uses native unshifted cm3/g STP).

data_contract.x_direction: ascending (note: desorption branch in Excel may be stored descending in P/P0 — sort or plot in native order)
constraints: CRITICAL for FigS6: Plot dV/dlog(W) (labeled 'dV/dlong(W)' in pore_size_dist.xlsx!), NEVER cumulative pore volume.
Fig2B is a multi-block 16-column sheet where row 0=unit, row 1=sample name (Cu\-(1.26)-MAZ), row 2+=data.
FigS6 original PDF is large format (9.00 x 7.68 in, 648x553 pt) with scaled fonts (36pt labels, 26pt ticks, 3.96pt lines) — match visual weight!

notes: Fig2B: 4 samples (Support, Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C), P/P0 0.0-1.0, Quantity adsorbed 0-160 cm3/g STP, matching solid/hollow markers.
FigS6: Linear x-axis 0.7-5.0 nm, y-axis 0.0-0.7 cm3/g, line + solid circle markers, exact colors (#B00F1A, #6699BA, #CCA8E3, #8CCF8C), top-right legend.
Note typo in author Excel column header: 'dV/dlong(W)' — display clean 'dV/dlog(W)' on y-axis label.
